content:
Right in time for both Black Friday deals and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim 's 15th anniversary, the Elder Scrolls official cookbook is available at an even lower price than a few weeks ago. You can pick one up for just over $15 at Amazon – that's 56% off of its original $35 price. This is an Amazon Lightning deal, so stock is limited.

If you want a deeper look at the book before buying it, we had got a sneak peek before its release a few years ago.

The 192-page themed Elder Scrolls cookbook is penned by Chelsea Monroe-Cassel, who has written loads of other pop culture-themed cookbooks for properties like World of Warcraft, Star Wars Galaxies Edge, Star Trek, and more. This Elder Scrolls edition features food, drink, and sweet treats found in multiple adventures throughout Tamriel, like the sweetroll from the now-timeless meme, as well as immersive recipes inspired by the different cultures found in the game.

Skyrim just celebrated its 15th anniversary on November 11; how better to start yet another playthrough than with a succulent Tamriel meal?

In other Elder Scrolls news, Bethesda has finally revealed the long-rumored title of the next mainline game in the series to be The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel. Sentinel is the capital city of the Hammerfell region, confirming fan speculation that the game will take place there. Finer details are sparse, and it appears we won't see the game for at least another two years.

Official Persona Cookbook Black Friday Deal

The Elder Scrolls isn't the only game with a discounted official cookbook available. The official Persona Cookbook is 50% off for Black Friday as an Amazon Lightning Deal.
